info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Status Retrieval API provides real-time information on the status of airline flights, enabling users to stay updated on delays, cancellations, and gate changes. This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of various flights, making it an essential resource for travelers, airline staff, and travel agencies. Use cases include monitoring flight schedules and ensuring timely travel arrangements. Developers can integrate this API into applications that assist with travel planning and real-time updates.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of a specific flight, including details such as delays, cancellations, and on-time departures. Simply provide the required flight information to get accurate status updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of flights. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the JSON format as defined by the schema.

ListAirlineFlightsStatusRequest.description: The JSON String representing the request body for retrieving flight status information.

ListAirlineFlightsStatusResponse_200.title: Flight Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the flight status.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the flight.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the status.

ListAirlineFlightsStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response for the flight status operation. It includes details about the flight status, reference number, processing time, and related audit information.
